## What problem does this solve

Describe the use case — what are you trying to do that Ferrite doesn't
support today?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see. If there's more than one reasonable approach,
mention the trade-offs you see.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you've thought about, including workarounds you're
using today.

## Scope check

Ferrite is a terminal-native system monitor. Before requesting a feature,
please check it fits that scope — see the README's "Planned features"
and "Project goals" sections. Features like a GUI, a web dashboard, or
remote telemetry are explicitly out of scope.
